The 27th International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference (ISMIR 2026) has just taken place, and we are pleased to announce that the following awards were given to C4DM members:

  • The Best student paper award was given to MAJEPPA: Morphing and Assessing in a Unified Piano Performance Space by Jinwen Zhou, Huan Zhang, Weixi Zhai, Jinhua Liang, Aidan Hogg, Simon Dixon

  • The Best paper award, honorable mention was given to LiveBand: Live Accompaniment Generation in the Audio Domain by Marco Pasini, Javier Nistal, Mathias R. Bjare, Stefan Lattner, George Fazekas

  • Best reviewer awards were given to C4DM PhD students Ben Hayes and Yannis Vasilakis

Congratulations to all! You can explore C4DM's contributions for ISMIR 2026 at: https://c4dm.eecs.qmul.ac.uk/news/2026-11-05.C4DM-at_ISMIR_2026/
